title: Commercial Fusion 2026: Plasma Physics to Plant Architecture
subtitle: Two-thirds of ITER's torus is installed while no breeding blanket, qualified alloy or net-gain plant exists [S4][S2]

current_gaps.title: Physics Gain, No Plant
current_gaps.spec: NIF holds the only gain factor above 1; no engineering-breakeven protocol exists [S6][S2]

current_gaps.title: Tritium Fuel Cycle
current_gaps.spec: No closed fuel cycle: breeding blanket unproven, tritium decays in 12.3 years [S2][S6]

current_gaps.title: Qualified Alloys Absent
current_gaps.spec: No neutron-resistant structural alloy or plasma-facing component spec qualified [S2][S6]

current_gaps.title: Authorised, Not Appropriated
current_gaps.spec: Unresolved: $1.1B authorised for FY2027, $790M appropriated, below $805.7M enacted [S2]

current_gaps.title: Fleet Census Conflict
current_gaps.spec: Unresolved: 28 companies [S2] vs around 30 [S3]; IAEA counts dozens [S5]

evolution_matrix.key_upgrade: Replaces shot-by-shot empirical tuning with an ML framework that predicts shifts between shots at DIII-D [S3]
Replaces scarce purchased tritium, half-life about 12.3 years, with lithium breeding blankets [S6][S2]
Replaces unqualified structural alloys with neutron-resistant plasma-facing components named in the DOE roadmap [S2][S6]
Replaces bespoke single lifts with a nine-module sequence: 6 in place, an approximately 1,100-tonne module lowered in 30 hours [S4]
Replaces annual appropriations, $790M against $1.1B authorised for FY2027, with roadmap milestone funding [S2]

core_pillars.title: Burning-Plasma Core
core_pillars.concise_spec: Nine sector modules at millimetre tolerances; final module mid-2027 [S4][S3]

core_pillars.title: Breeding Blanket Loop
core_pillars.concise_spec: Lithium breeding blanket closes the loop; tritium half-life 12.3 years [S6][S3]

core_pillars.title: Neutron-Resistant Wall
core_pillars.concise_spec: Structural alloys and plasma-facing components; Electra 90,000 shots in 10 hours [S2][S6]

core_pillars.title: Predictive Plasma Control
core_pillars.concise_spec: DIII-D ML framework predicts shot-to-shot shifts; 120 magnetic sensors per sector [S3]

core_pillars.title: Deployment & Regulation
core_pillars.concise_spec: Office of Fusion created November 2025; IAEA regulation report 23 February 2026 [S2][S5]

expansion_stages.label: Test Rig
expansion_stages.detail: Electra repetition proves component endurance before any plasma campaign [S6]

expansion_stages.label: Sector
expansion_stages.detail: One module integrated to millimetre tolerances before pit transfer [S4]

expansion_stages.label: Tokamak
expansion_stages.detail: Nine sectors joined; 93 bellows welded over five years [S4][S3]

expansion_stages.label: Fleet
expansion_stages.detail: $4.48B raised to July 2026; deployment target mid-2030s [S2]

validation_benches.title: Sector Alignment
validation_benches.test_criteria: Nine sectors positioned to millimetre tolerances; 30-hour lift per module [S4]

validation_benches.title: Tritium Loop Closure
validation_benches.test_criteria: Blanket loop closes with tritium decay half-life held at 12.3 years [S6]

validation_benches.title: Gain Above Unity
validation_benches.test_criteria: Pass: gain factor above 1, then orders of magnitude to engineering breakeven [S6][S2]

validation_benches.title: Coil Full Current
validation_benches.test_criteria: 330-metric-ton toroidal field coil reaches full current in ramp trials [S3]
